title: STEM 1
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: reliably reproduce central basic concepts of projection (set theory).
know how to articulate geometric questions precisely using the appropriate technical terms.
recognise, understand and reproduce, meaningful connections and proof elements or derivations in the field of geometry and the mapping of three-dimensional objects on two-dimensional planes.
apply techniques of vector calculus and matrix algebra to geometrical problems and to questions of the position and representation of spatial objects.
analyse geometric problems in the plane and space, while selecting the appropriate tools from those provided.
Coordinates of Points and Vectors, Change of Coordinate Frames
Linear Perspective: Image Construction using Desargues' Theorem
Points at Infinity and Vanishing Points
Camera Models in Computer Graphics and Computer Vision
All contents of course a) are applied and practised.

reading_list.reference: Anton, Howard; Rorres, Chris; Kaul, Anton: Elementary Linear Algebra: Applications Version (12th Edition), Wiley, 2019, ISBN: 1119282365.
Lengyel, Eric: Mathematics for 3D Game Programming and Computer Graphics (3rd Edition), Cengage Learning PTR, 2011, ISBN: 1435458869.
